title: Fellowships and Thesis Funding
intro: Empowering Egyptian students, researchers, and graduation project teams through the national Best Thesis Award, direct Thesis Prototyping Funds, and global Optica Foundation fellowships.

bestThesisAward.title: Best Thesis Award in Photonics
bestThesisAward.description: Annual nationwide competition recognizing outstanding bachelor capstone projects, master theses, and doctoral dissertations across Egyptian faculties of Engineering and Science.

categories.prize: Cash Honorarium, Section Trophy, and Conference Presentation
categories.eligibility: Senior engineering and science teams graduating from accredited Egyptian universities.

categories.prize: Research Honorarium, Travel Fellowship, and Publication Support
categories.eligibility: M.Sc. graduates who defended their thesis within the past academic year in optics or photonics.

categories.prize: Distinguished Scholar Plaque, Keynote Invitation, and Grant Subsidy
categories.eligibility: Ph.D. holders from Egyptian universities or joint cotutelle programs in optical science.

evaluationCriteria: Scientific and technical novelty in optics, photonics, or quantum engineering
Potential for commercialization, patenting, or international journal publication
Clarity of thesis documentation, open reproducible data, and presentation

thesisFund.title: Optica Egypt Thesis Fund
thesisFund.grantAmount: Up to 25,000 EGP per Thesis Team
thesisFund.description: A dedicated funding initiative created to alleviate foreign currency and component scarcity for Egyptian students. The fund provides direct seed grants to purchase physical hardware, micro-sensors, and cloud simulation hours for graduation and post-graduate theses.

eligibleExpenses.items: Fiber patch cords, collimators, laser diodes, photodiodes, optical filters, and beam splitters.
Microcontroller boards, sensor ICs, PCB fabrication, and 3D printing filaments.
Cloud high-performance computing (HPC) GPU hours and MPW silicon layout submission fees.

applicationProcess: Submit a two-page project proposal detailing thesis objectives, faculty advisor endorsement, and itemized budget.
Technical review by the Optica Egypt Academic Advisory Committee within 14 days.
Direct disbursement of grant funds or direct purchasing assistance for specialized components.
thesisFund.deadline: Continuous Rolling Applications (Fall and Spring Cycles)

globalFellowships.title: Optica Foundation Student Travel Grants
globalFellowships.description: Enabling Egyptian undergraduate and graduate students presenting accepted papers at Frontiers in Optics (FiO) or CLEO to travel and participate in-person.

globalFellowships.title: Siegman International School on Lasers Fellowship
globalFellowships.description: Fully funded fellowship sending one outstanding Egyptian laser physics or optics student each year to the world's most prestigious week-long laser summer school.

globalFellowships.title: Optica Women Scholars Award
globalFellowships.description: Multi-year scholarship awarded to promising female undergraduate and graduate students pursuing degrees in optics and photonics, accompanied by executive mentorship.

globalFellowships.title: Amplify Scholarship for Underrepresented Students
globalFellowships.description: Supporting talented optics and physics students overcoming geographic and socioeconomic obstacles to complete advanced photonic degrees.

elevations.title: Senior Member and Fellow Elevations
elevations.description: Optica Egypt actively guides and supports mid-career and senior Egyptian researchers through the international peer-review process to achieve Senior Member and Fellow milestones.

tiers.perks: International recognition, senior committee eligibility, and peer review leadership.
tiers.support: Section advisory committee provides reference letters, nomination packaging, and dossier review.

tiers.perks: Top 0.5 percent lifetime distinction in optics and photonics worldwide.
tiers.support: Coordinated endorsement from current Egyptian and international Fellows.
